title: Maternal Continuity Journey
description: A reusable schema for representing a de-identified maternal-care continuity journey and its related events, referrals and follow-up records.

journey_id.description: Pseudonymous or synthetic identifier for the maternal-care journey.

region.description: Optional broad implementation region such as a state or district.

journey_status.description: High-level status of the maternal-care journey.

events.description: Journey events associated with this maternal-care journey.

referrals.description: Referral records associated with this maternal-care journey.

follow_ups.description: Follow-up records associated with this maternal-care journey.
